summary: Creates an index buffer through a virtual call at vtable offset 96 on the sub-object stored at this+0x1100. Derives usage flags from a2[0] bits (0x2/0x10 -> 8, 0x20 -> 0x200) and passes buffer size 2 * a2[1] with format id 101. Stores the call result in *this; returns 0 on success, or -1 (with an error log) on NULL a2 or a failed creation. Called by sub_53EB70, sub_540940 and sub_558310.

local_names.this: owner object whose sub-object at +0x1100 owns the render device
local_names.a2: index-buffer description record (flags at a2[0], element count at a2[1], additional data at a2+6)
local_names.v3: accumulated usage flags (8 for 0x2/0x10 bits, 0x200 for 0x20 bit)
local_names.v5: return value of the virtual create-buffer call

operations.description: If a2 is NULL, log sub_53C590(-1, aInvalidParamet) and return -1
Derive usage flags from a2[0] bits: set v3 = 8 when bit 0x2 set, OR 8 when bit 0x10 set, OR 0x200 when bit 0x20 set
Virtual call at offset 96 (vtable[24]) on the sub-object at this+0x1100 with arguments (this[1088], 2 * a2[1], v3, 101, 0, a2 + 6) to create the index buffer
Store the virtual call result v5 into *this
If the virtual call result is nonzero, log sub_53C590(-1, aErrorCreatingI) and return -1
Return 0 on successful buffer creation, -1 on NULL a2 or creation failure
Invoked by sub_53EB70 (0053EB70), sub_540940 (00540940) and sub_558310 (00558310) to allocate GPU index buffers
